column2: Notably, modal double-faced permanents and melded permanents are never transformed permanents
column3: Superseded: under the current CR 701.27a a modal double-faced permanent can transform, and CR 701.27g excludes only permanents represented by more than one card (melded, merged) from being transformed permanents; the engine follows the current rule (transform_rules.rs; the rest of 701.27g is tested in tests/rulings/r_p225_transform_faces.rs)

column2: modal double-faced permanents can't enter transformed, even if they enter with their back faces up
column3: Superseded: under the current CR 701.27a and 701.27g a modal double-faced permanent with its back face up is a transformed permanent (only melded and merged permanents are excluded); the engine follows the current rule (transform_rules.rs)
